material_field: Rest weights fixed per p. E(p)=p+we(p)(Re(p-ce)+ce-p); full F(p)=E(p)+ws(p)(Rs(E(p)-cs)+cs-E(p)). Do not recompute ws at E(p). Upperarm does not receive E.
parent_assumption: Source-rest-space parent motion Ps(theta_s) composed with Pe(theta_e), evaluated E then S; fixed-pivot ce is in shoulder-rest frame, its world position is Ps(ce). Author must independently confirm actual local parent inverse/P0 mapping and Core indices.
factored_solution: For actual old-glue every non-upperarm vertex ws==1. Thus upperarm local compensation depends only on shoulder (9 1-degree keys); forearm+cuff compensation only on elbow (13 keys); palms/fingers need no compensation. No117-key geometry grid is mathematically necessary for these exact rest weights/hierarchy.
not_proven: New authored API/MOC realizes source-local compensation
Actual Core geometry/glue or raster seams
Body deformation composed with joint axes
New mesh topology or refreshed indices
